conditions.value: exudate, size, and depth to require specialized therapy

conditions.exception: unless edema and/or exudate mandates NPWT

value: Documentation in medical record of evaluation, care, and wound measurements by a licensed medical professional

Consideration of risk factors addressed in documentation (bleeding, anticoagulants, friable vessels, vascular anastomosis, infected wounds, osteomyelitis, exposed organs/vessels/nerves/tendons/ligaments, sharp edges, spinal cord injury, enteric fistulas)
Requirement addressed for MRI, hyperbaric chamber, defibrillation, size and weight, use near vagus nerve, circumferential dressing, mode of therapy
Application of dressings to maintain a moist wound environment
Debridement of necrotic tissue if present
Evaluation of and provision for adequate nutritional status

conditional_wound_specific_requirements.wound_type: Stage III or IV pressure ulcers
requirements: Patient has been appropriately turned and positioned
Patient's moisture and incontinence have been appropriately managed
Patient with diabetes has been on a comprehensive diabetic management program
Foot ulcer has been appropriately off-loaded
Compression bandages and/or garments have been consistently applied only after Ankle-Brachial Index has been done per guidelines
Leg elevation with alternating ambulation has been encouraged

conditions.value: initiated after wound treatments described under sections A-a through A-d have been tried or considered and ruled out

complications of surgically created wound (e.g., dehiscence) or traumatic wound (e.g., pre-operative flap or graft) with documented medical necessity for accelerated formation of granulation tissue which cannot be achieved by other available topical wound treatments
approved as covered by the health plan in advance of the procedure
directly assess the wound(s) being treated on a regular basis
supervise or directly perform the NPWT dressing changes
document changes in the ulcer's dimensions and characteristics and the degree of granulation and management of exudate
show a contraindication does not exist

exclusions: Presence in the wound of necrotic tissue with eschar, if debridement has not been carried out
Untreated osteomyelitis within the vicinity of the wound
Possibility of malignant cells present in the wound
Presence of a fistula to an organ or body cavity within the vicinity of the wound
Recent lab value for albumin equal to or less than 2.5

dressing_kits_limit.unit: dressing kits per wound per 30-day period
dressing_kits_limit.exception: unless there is documentation that the wound size requires more than one dressing kit for each dressing change

canister_sets_limit.exception: unless there is documentation evidencing a large volume of drainage (greater than 90 ml of exudate per day)

coverage_termination_criteria: Criteria for Continued Coverage cease to occur
In the judgment of the treating physician, adequate wound granulation has occurred to the degree that NPWT may be discontinued

Wound is not healing progressively (progressive wound healing has failed to occur over the prior 30 days based on documented quantitative measurements of wound characteristics including length, width, or depth, serially observed and documented)
